app_description: An app for controlling the Manafish ROV
app_connection_page_description: Configure your Manafish connection settings. Only change this if you know what you are doing.
app_connection_ip_address_description: The IP address of your Manafish.
app_connection_webrtc_signaling_api_port: The port number for the WebRTC signaling API (used for establishing the video stream connection).
app_connection_webrtc_signaling_api_path: The path for the WebRTC signaling API.
app_connection_web_socket_port_descripti: The port number for the WebSocket connection (used for controlling the ROV and obtaining status).
general_settings_page_description: Generic settings for the Manafish application.
general_settings_app_version_description: Current version of the Manafish application.
general_settings_video_directory_descrip: Set the directory where recordings are stored.
general_settings_appearance_theme_descri: Select the color scheme for the application.
general_settings_appearance_overlay_scal: Adjust the scale of the overlay UI.
general_settings_appearance_attitude_ind: Select the style of the attitude indicator.
general_settings_appearance_thruster_rpm: Show the thruster RPM overlay on the video feed.
general_rov_settings_page_description: Generic settings for the Manafish ROV.
general_rov_settings_firmware_version_de: Current version of the Manafish ROV firmware.
general_rov_settings_microcontroller_fir: Select and flash the firmware with the specified output protocol for the microcontroller that generates the control signals for the thrusters. DSHOT is a modern digital protocol that supports bi-directional communication, allowing reading of thruster RPM, voltage, current and temperature. However, it can be more sensitive to noise and may introduce higher latency if the ESCs are not powerful enough. PWM is the older analog protocol and does not support feedback, but it is generally more robust. It is recommended to use DSHOT first, and switch to PWM only if you encounter issues.
general_rov_settings_fluid_type_descript: Set correct fluid type to get accurate water pressure readings.
general_rov_settings_smoothing_factor_de: How much smoothing applied to the movement of the ROV. Smoothing can be nice for getting smooth movement and camera shots, but it can also make the ROV feel less responsive. 0 leads to no smoothing. As the value approaches 1, the smoothing increases exponentially.
calibration_page_description: Calibrate the thrusters of the ROV.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_descripti: Use this table to configure each thruster connected to your ROV. For each pin, choose the identifier by observing which thruster spins when you test it and adjust the spin direction so that the thruster rotates forward according to your propeller type.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_pin_toolt: The general purpose pin on the microcontroller that the thruster is connected to.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_identifie: Identifier to be used for the thruster in the thruster allocation.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_spin_dire: The default spin direction for the propeller on the thruster.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_test_tool: Spins the thruster slowly in the specified direction on the specified pin.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_rpm_toolt: The revolutions per minute of the thruster.
calibration_thruster_allocation_descript: Use this matrix to control how each thruster responds to different movement input. Assign a value between -1 and 1 to specify the amount of thrust each thruster should provide: positive values produce forward thrust, negative values produce reverse thrust, and 0 disables the thruster for that action.
calibration_thruster_allocation_identifi: Identifier for the given thruster, defined in the pin setup.
calibration_thruster_allocation_surge_to: Thrusters to activate to move forward
calibration_thruster_allocation_sway_too: Thrusters to activate to move right
calibration_thruster_allocation_heave_to: Thrusters to activate to move upwards
calibration_thruster_allocation_pitch_to: Thrusters to activate to pitch up
calibration_thruster_allocation_yaw_tool: Thrusters to activate to yaw right
calibration_thruster_allocation_roll_too: Thrusters to activate to roll right
calibration_thruster_allocation_action_1: Thrusters to activate for action 1 (custom or auxiliary function).
calibration_thruster_allocation_action_2: Thrusters to activate for action 2 (custom or auxiliary function).
regulator_page_description: Adjust the regulator settings for the ROV.
regulator_pid_turn_speed_description: The speed of which the ROV will try to reach the desired position by the PID controller.
regulator_direction_coefficients_descrip: Set the relative power for moving or turning in each direction. The ratios between these values determine how much force each thruster will use to move in the expected direction without drifting. The units don't matter as long as all axes use the same units.
power_page_description: Configure your Manafish power and battery settings.
power_user_max_power_description: The percentage of power given to the thrusters from user input.
power_user_max_power_actions_description: The percentage of power given to the motors for actions from user input.
power_regulator_max_power_description: The percentage of power given to the thrusters by the regulator to keep the ROV stabilized.
power_battery_min_voltage_description: The voltage of the battery when it is fully depleted. This will show as 0% battery in the app. Please include a margin to avoid damaging the battery.
power_battery_max_voltage_description: The voltage of the battery when it is fully charged. This will show as 100% battery in the app.
keyboard_page_description: Configure your keyboard bindings for controlling the ROV.
gamepad_page_description: Configure your gamepad bindings for controlling the ROV.
gamepad_no_gamepad_connected_description: Please connect a gamepad to configure the bindings.
debug_page_description: Debug console for the ROV and the application.
gamepad_select_to_edit_bindings: Select a gamepad to edit bindings.
gamepad_selected_not_connected: The selected gamepad is not connected. Reconnect it to capture input.
alerts_recording_in_progress_description: If you navigate to settings, the recording will be stopped and saved.
